purpose: Characterize serial-dependence uncertainty in the already-opened 2024 primary sample without changing the signal, horizon, alignment, source, sign, or outcome.

immutable_parent_rules.sample: exact 248 primary post-Dencun 2024 observations emitted by EDFF-FD45-REPLICATION-001
immutable_parent_rules.outcome: same next-day-open to +45d ETHUSDT log return
immutable_parent_rules.model: same linear slope beta of future return on FD

circular_shift_null.statistic: OLS beta after circularly shifting FD relative to returns
circular_shift_null.p_value: two-sided fraction of admissible shifted |beta| >= observed |beta| with +1 correction

calendar_quarter_signs.rule: report beta separately for 2024Q2, Q3 and available Q4 observations; no selection or gate

classification_rules.ROBUSTNESS_SUPPORTIVE_NOT_PROMOTIONAL: bootstrap beta 95% lower > 0 AND circular-shift p < 0.05
classification_rules.ROBUSTNESS_PARTIAL_NOT_PROMOTIONAL: observed beta > 0 AND exactly one of those two conditions holds
classification_rules.ROBUSTNESS_WEAK_NOT_PROMOTIONAL: observed beta > 0 AND neither condition holds

hard_boundary: This audit cannot upgrade the parent REPLICATION_MIXED verdict.
